title: EXODUS 23:25
PRAYER FOR RESTORATION
end: The Healing Balm — receive God's healing peace
stock_queries: tranquil turquoise living waters gentle ripples
warm golden sanctuary light filtering through trees
peaceful white dove resting near quiet waters
calm mountain stream under soft morning light
glowing sunlight on calm turquoise lake surface
gentle stream flowing through quiet green valley
soft golden light illuminating tranquil water

scenes.a: If your body feels drained and weariness weighs down your steps, pause and listen closely right now.
Father, we come before your presence seeking your comforting touch and your abiding strength.
Your holy word reminds us of your promise to care for our daily needs.
As it is written, And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water;
and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
Lord, grant physical renewal to every weary muscle and tired spirit listening today.
Pour out your peace like gentle water upon troubled thoughts and anxious hearts.
